tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the projects you own or can access, newest first, with cursor pagination. view=active (default) hides archived and trashed projects; pass view=archived or view=trash to see those.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get one project by ID — name, description, settings, visibility, version and deployment fields. Read this before update_project so you change the current version, not a stale copy.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new, empty project (optionally seeded with a file map). Counts against the plan's project quota. To start from a starter instead, use use_template.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a project's name, description, files, settings or visibility. Files passed here REPLACE the matching paths. Pass the `version` you read with get_project to avoid overwriting someone else's newer edit (the API answers 409 on a conflict).

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Move a project to the trash. It disappears from every list and route immediately; restore_project brings it back during the retention window. Confirm with the user first — anything published from it stops being editable.

tools.name: restore_project
tools.description: Restore a project from the trash. A project that was archived before it was trashed returns to the archive, not to the active list.

tools.name: archive_project
tools.description: Archive (archived=true) or un-archive (archived=false) a project. Archiving hides it from the active list without deleting anything; it is fully reversible.

tools.name: duplicate_project
tools.description: Copy a project (files and settings) into a new project you own, named after the original. Counts against the plan's project quota. Any member with read access may duplicate.

tools.name: get_project_files
tools.description: Get a project's file tree with file contents. Use this to read code before answering questions about it or proposing an update_project change.

tools.name: write_project_files
tools.description: Create, update or delete files in a project (1–100 per call, each up to 1 MB; paths are relative, no `..`). Other files are left as they are. Overwrites and deletes are applied to the working files immediately — confirm with the user, and use list_checkpoints/restore_checkpoint to undo. Pass `version` (from get_project) to refuse the write if anything changed since you read it. The published site does not change until you deploy again.

tools.name: import_artifact
tools.description: Import a published Misar artifact page into a project as imported/ARTIFACT_ID.html. The url must be exactly https://misar.ai/code/artifact/ARTIFACT_ID; anything else is refused before any fetch.

tools.name: get_project_knowledge
tools.description: Read a project's knowledge — the standing notes (product context, conventions, constraints) the AI builder reads on every change.

tools.name: update_project_knowledge
tools.description: Replace a project's knowledge (up to 20,000 characters) — the standing notes the AI builder reads on every change. This replaces the whole text, so read it with get_project_knowledge first and send the edited version.

tools.name: get_project_backend
tools.description: Show a full-stack project's database backend: whether one is provisioned, its schema name, table count and connection state.

tools.name: provision_project_backend
tools.description: Provision the database backend for a full-stack project: its own isolated schema, protected by row-level security. Safe to repeat — an already-provisioned project reports its existing backend.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the starter templates a new project can begin from, with their IDs, names and categories. Pick one here before calling use_template.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get one template by ID — its description, stack and the files it would create.

tools.name: use_template
tools.description: Create a new project from a template. Returns the new project; counts against the plan's project quota.

tools.name: deploy_project
tools.description: Publish a project to the public internet on the MisarDev runtime (optionally at a chosen subdomain). The site becomes reachable by anyone. Confirm with the user before calling, check the address first with check_subdomain, and follow with get_deployment_status. Counts against the plan's deploy quota.

tools.name: get_deployment_status
tools.description: Get a project's current deployment: whether it is live, its URL, subdomain and custom-domain state. Call after deploy_project to confirm the site is actually up before telling anyone it is.

tools.name: unpublish_project
tools.description: Take a published site offline. Its public URL stops serving immediately. This is not a rollback — to go back to an earlier version, restore_checkpoint and deploy again. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: check_subdomain
tools.description: Check whether a subdomain label is free for this project and, if not, get suggestions. The project's own current subdomain reads as available.

tools.name: update_project_subdomain
tools.description: Move a project to a new <subdomain>.misar.app address (check it first with check_subdomain). If the app is published, the live site moves immediately and the OLD address stops working — get the user's explicit approval. If it is not published yet, this just reserves the name for the next deploy.

tools.name: list_builds
tools.description: List your recent AI builds across all projects, newest first, with status, model and the project each belongs to.

tools.name: get_build_status
tools.description: Get whether a project currently has a build running and its latest build state. Poll this rather than assuming a build finished.

tools.name: cancel_build
tools.description: Cancel the build currently running on a project. Work the build had not yet saved is discarded.

tools.name: list_checkpoints
tools.description: List a project's saved checkpoints (up to 100, newest first) with label, changed paths and timestamp. Checkpoints are the project's version history — use one to undo a bad change.

tools.name: restore_checkpoint
tools.description: Restore a project's files to a checkpoint. The current state is snapshotted first, so the restore itself can be undone — but it does overwrite the working files, so confirm with the user. A published site does not change until you deploy again.

tools.name: rename_checkpoint
tools.description: Give a checkpoint a human-readable label (1–80 characters) so it is easy to find later.

tools.name: delete_checkpoint
tools.description: Delete one checkpoint from a project's version history. It can no longer be restored afterwards, and the last remaining checkpoint cannot be deleted. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: get_custom_domain
tools.description: Get a project's custom domain, its status, the DNS record the user must set, and whether DNS already resolves to the platform (TLS is issued automatically once it does).

tools.name: set_custom_domain
tools.description: Attach a domain the user owns to a published project and provision routing/TLS. Paid plans only (the API answers with an upgrade offer otherwise). Returns the DNS record to set — the domain only serves once that record is live.

tools.name: remove_custom_domain
tools.description: Detach a project's custom domain and remove its route. The domain stops serving the app immediately; the default subdomain keeps working. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: Look up a domain's public registration data (RDAP): whether it is registered, its registrar and key dates. Useful before suggesting a custom domain.

tools.name: search_workspace
tools.description: Search across your projects and the public catalogue (templates, skills, the published gallery) by name and description. Does NOT search inside project files — use search_project_code for that. A source that could not be reached is reported as unavailable, never as zero results.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Answer a question from the live web with citations (MisarDev's grounded search). Returns the answer, url_citation annotations and the ranked sources. Spends model credits; quote only what the sources support.

tools.name: create_chat_completion
tools.description: Run a one-shot, non-streaming chat completion on MisarDev's OpenAI-compatible model API. model='misar-online' grounds the answer in the web with citations; omit model for the default coding model. Spends model credits.

tools.name: index_project_code
tools.description: Index a project's files for semantic code search (RAG). Pass the files to index as a path → content map; re-indexing a path replaces it. Metered — a paid-plan feature.

tools.name: search_project_code
tools.description: Semantic search inside an indexed project's code. Answer only from the snippets it returns and cite their file paths; if get_code_index_stats shows nothing indexed, index first.

tools.name: get_code_index_stats
tools.description: Get embedding statistics for a project — how many files and chunks are indexed and when.

tools.name: clear_code_index
tools.description: Delete every embedding for a project. Code search returns nothing until the project is indexed again. Project files are not touched.

tools.name: upgrade
tools.description: Show the current MisarDev plan, how much of each quota (builds, edits, projects) is left this period, and the link to compare plans and upgrade. Call it any time — not only after hitting a limit. Reads only: it never changes the plan or takes payment. On a local install, open=true also opens the pricing page in the user's browser.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get detailed usage for the account. format=quick returns a lightweight summary, format=dashboard the full dashboard data; analytics=true adds a per-day breakdown over `days` (default 30). For plan limits at a glance, use upgrade.

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.description: Get the account's subscription: plan, status, current period end and whether it cancels at period end.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List MisarDev's plans with prices, limits and features — what each upgrade would unlock.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List your notifications (build finished, deploy failed, invitations…), newest first, with the unread count. Pass `before` (an ISO timestamp from the last row) to page back; unread_only=true returns just the count.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark every notification as read, clearing the unread badge. Nothing is deleted.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List your API keys — name, prefix, created/expiry dates and IP allowlist. Never returns the secret.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a new API key. The raw key is returned ONCE — hand it to the user and never repeat or store it. Every MisarDev key has full API access; keys expire (default 90 days, max 365).

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key by ID. It is deleted permanently and anything still using it fails immediately. Confirm with the user first, and never revoke the key this session is using without saying so.

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.description: Mark one notification as read (use mark_notifications_read for all of them).

tools.name: list_audit_log
tools.description: List your own audit trail — API-key, deployment and billing events where you were the actor, newest first. Needs a plan that includes audit logs; otherwise it returns an upgrade message.

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: List the connectors available on MisarDev and whether each is enabled for you, with its category, status and dashboard path.

tools.name: toggle_connector
tools.description: Enable or disable a connector by slug (from list_connectors). Reversible.

prompts.name: ship_a_project
prompts.description: Take a project from a template to a live, verified deployment.

prompts.name: undo_a_bad_change
prompts.description: Roll a project back to an earlier checkpoint and, if it was live, redeploy.

prompts.name: deployment_health
prompts.description: Review recent builds and deployments and say what needs attention.

prompts.name: search_the_codebase
prompts.description: Answer a question about a project from its indexed code.

prompts.name: usage_and_keys_audit
prompts.description: Review plan usage and API keys for anything unexpected.

resources.name: Projects
resources.description: Your active projects, newest first — the IDs every other tool takes.

resources.name: Templates
resources.description: Available starter templates, so a new project begins from a real one.

resources.name: Plan and quota
resources.description: Current plan and remaining builds, edits and projects this period — the baseline for any quota question.
